queue.title: Selective lookahead gate
queue.hypothesis: Observable epistemic-state features can identify states where two-step lookahead has positive downstream option value, allowing selective use of deep search to improve causal recovery per unit compute versus always-one-step and always-two-step policies.
queue.design: Use the 24 RNG-isolated paired worlds as offline treatment-effect data. Extract only agent-observable initial posterior features (entropy, top mass, top-two gap, edge uncertainty, top-hypothesis disagreement). Train a simple interpretable gate on one half and evaluate on held-out worlds; then prospectively test the selected gate on new worlds under equal experiment budget while accounting for compute.
queue.primary_metric: edge error adjusted by compute or Pareto dominance over recovery and compute

queue.title: Unconditional three-step or MCTS epistemic search
queue.reason: EXP-002F found no primary benefit from unconditional two-step depth at ~9x compute; deeper unconditional search is not justified until selective gating is tested.

queue.title: Parallel designer proposals plus tree search
queue.hypothesis: Epistemically diverse proposal generation improves search quality relative to a single proposal generator when search budget is fixed.

queue.title: Reward and credit assignment ablation
queue.hypothesis: Counterfactual or trajectory-aware credit can improve policy learning once downstream value estimates are available.

queue.title: Model misspecification transfer
queue.hypothesis: A controller that succeeds only when its Bayesian world class is correct will degrade under nonlinear, confounded, imperfect-intervention, or nonstationary worlds; model-uncertainty mechanisms should reduce that degradation.

dynamic_enqueue_rules: Every completed experiment must generate at least one next candidate unless a stronger queued candidate already tests the same uncertainty.
Falsification never empties the queue; it narrows or redirects it.
Do not enqueue equivalent retries without a changed causal hypothesis, state representation, reward, search depth, world model, or evaluation design.
Promote surprising anomalies and control victories into diagnostic experiments.
Maintain matched resource budgets and preserve all negative results.
